description: This source file defines the ITransactionManagerExtension interface within the Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions namespace. The interface declares methods related to transaction management, such as preparing, committing, and pinging transactions, intended for extension of Orleans grains in a transactional context.

classes.name: ITransactionManagerExtension
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainExtension to provide transaction management functions for Orleans grains, including preparing, committing, and pinging transactions.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction with specified resource ID, transaction ID, access count, timestamp, write resources, and total participants.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Notifies that a participant has prepared, with transaction status and other details.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping for the given transaction and resource.
